rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides AI assistants with feature flag management capabilities for Bucketeer, an open-source feature flag platform, built using TypeScript with the Model Context Protocol SDK and comprehensive error handling. The implementation offers five core tools for complete CRUD operations: listing feature flags with filtering and pagination support, creating new flags with configurable variations and targeting rules, retrieving specific flags by ID, updating existing flags with audit trail requirements, and archiving flags to make them inactive. Built with Zod schema validation, axios-based HTTP client with proper error mapping, and environment-based configuration supporting flexible deployment scenarios, it serves DevOps teams managing feature rollouts across multiple environments, product managers needing conversational access to feature flag controls, and development teams wanting to integrate feature flag operations into AI-assisted workflows without direct API interaction.
